name: Isabelle Dubois
bio:
Isabelle's journey in motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the data labs. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Leuven, she started as a junior data analyst for a small Formula 3 team. Her sharp analytical skills and insightful recommendations quickly caught the attention of senior engineers, leading to a promotion to race strategist within two years. 

Her transition into team management was a natural progression, driven by her innate ability to foster collaboration and optimize performance. Isabelle believes in empowering her team, fostering a culture of open communication, and leveraging data-driven insights to make informed decisions. She is known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her uncanny ability to identify and nurture talent within her team. Isabelle's innovative spirit and commitment to pushing boundaries make her a distinctive leader in the high-stakes world of motorsport.

Now at Toyota Gazoo Racing, Isabelle focuses on long-term strategy and technological advancements. She actively promotes internal research and development and collaboration with external partners to keep the team at the forefront of innovation.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, subtly layered with a slight wave
physical.description: Isabelle has a thoughtful expression and carries herself with quiet confidence.

quirks: Always has a cup of herbal tea on her desk.
Carries a small notebook where she jots down observations throughout the day.
Has a habit of tapping her pen when deep in thought.
